_meta.source: Narutopedia (naruto.fandom.com) via MediaWiki API, 2026-10-22. Rank/seals with rank_source='canon' come from the wiki infoboxes; 'estimated' means the wiki lists no rank and one was assigned for game balance. Hand seals listed are the primary canon sequence (some jutsu have alternative sequences in different media).
_meta.notes: Learn requirements, ranges and game mechanics are design suggestions, not canon.

special_seals.name: Clone Seal
special_seals.description: Cross-shaped seal (index and middle fingers of both hands crossed) used for Shadow Clone Technique variants.

special_seals.name: Seal of Confrontation
special_seals.description: Half Tiger/Ram one-handed seal; universal sign of engagement before a spar.

special_seals.name: Seal of Reconciliation
special_seals.description: Two hands linked by middle and index fingers after a spar, showing the opponents remain comrades.

special_seals.name: Yang Water (Jin)
special_seals.description: Non-zodiac seal used in long Water Release sequences such as Water Dragon Bullet.

rules: Same-level clash: the superior nature wins.
A weaker nature can still overpower a stronger one if its technique is of a higher level (rank/chakra).
Same nature, same level: the techniques counterbalance and cancel out; different level: the higher wins.
Supporting combos exist in practice (e.g. wind feeding fire makes a stronger flame).

yin_yang.yin: spiritual energy / imagination - basis of genjutsu
yin_yang.yang: physical energy / vitality - basis of body-enhancing techniques

kekkei_genkai_natures.dead_bone_pulse: not a nature; bloodline control over one's own bone structure

nature_cycle.game_suggestion: Rock-paper-scissors damage multiplier (e.g. x1.5 superior, x0.75 inferior) applied when jutsu clash or when hitting an enemy with an elemental affinity; rank difference can override. Players get 1 random affinity at Academy graduation (affinity paper test), may train a 2nd at chunin and a 3rd+ at jonin. Kekkei genkai natures are bloodline-locked at character creation.

jutsu.canon_description: Creates intangible illusory copies of the user that vanish when struck; cannot attack.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Spawns 1-3 decoy AI dummies that draw enemy aggro and pop on hit. Learn: academy (required for graduation exam); taught by Academy instructor after a hand-seal drill minigame.

jutsu.canon_description: Changes the user's appearance into another person, animal or object; it is an illusion-like disguise that breaks under strong impact.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Swap player model to an NPC/prop for stealth and infiltration quests; breaks on damage. Learn: academy; class lesson plus a 'fool the guard' practical.

jutsu.canon_description: Instantly swaps the user's position with a nearby object (usually a log) just before an attack lands.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Perfect-timed dodge: on hit within a parry window, leave a log and teleport a short distance behind/side; chakra cost + cooldown. Learn: academy; dodge-timing training.

jutsu.canon_description: Lets the user slip out of ropes or bindings by manipulating joints and body position.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Passive/active escape: reduces duration of bind/grab status effects; mash-to-escape bonus. Learn: academy.

jutsu.canon_description: High-speed movement technique that lets the user travel short-to-long distances almost instantly, often hidden by smoke or leaves.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Mid-range blink dash (8-15 m) with leaf/smoke VFX; also fast-travel between nearby map points out of combat. Learn: genin; taught by jonin-sensei after mastering chakra control.

jutsu.canon_description: Paralyses the target's body for a short time, preventing movement.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Targeted short stun (1-2 s) with line-of-sight; bosses resist. Learn: genin; scroll from village library.

jutsu.canon_description: Creates solid clones that can fight independently; each holds an equal share of the user's chakra and their experience returns to the user when dispelled.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Summon 1-4 combat clones that use the player's basic attacks; dispelling grants training XP bonus (training multiplier). Learn: chunin or late genin; forbidden scroll quest or special teacher.

jutsu.canon_description: A second shuriken is hidden in the shadow of the first so the target only sees one.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Thrown shuriken spawns a delayed hidden second projectile; hard to dodge. Learn: genin; weapons instructor.

jutsu.canon_description: Multiplies a thrown shuriken or kunai into a storm of real copies.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Single throw becomes a wide fan of 20-50 solid projectiles. Learn: jonin; requires Shadow Clone + weapons mastery.

jutsu.canon_description: Space-time technique that calls an animal (or object) the user has signed a blood contract with, using blood and chakra.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Costs HP + chakra; summons an allied AI creature whose size scales with chakra spent (small helper -> giant boss-scale ally). Learn: genin/chunin; sign a contract scroll found via quest or offered by a teacher.

jutsu.canon_description: The contracted animals summon the user to their location instead.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Out-of-combat teleport to a summon realm hub (training / sage area). Learn: unlocked by summon-contract questline.

jutsu.canon_description: Kneads chakra into fire and exhales it as a large fireball (or stream) that craters the ground on impact; size scales with chakra.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Charged slow projectile that explodes in an AoE and leaves burning ground; hold to grow. Learn: genin with Fire affinity; practice at a lake/dock until fireball reaches size threshold (rite-of-passage quest).

jutsu.name_en: Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique
jutsu.canon_description: Exhales several small, independently guided fireballs; shuriken can be hidden inside them.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Fan of 5-8 homing-lite fireballs; upgrade hides shuriken inside for bonus damage. Learn: genin, Fire affinity; scroll.

jutsu.canon_description: Breathes fire along a wire or string toward the target, burning them at the other end.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Combo finisher: if target is tethered by Ninja Wire, fire travels along the wire for high damage; else a mid-range flame line. Learn: chunin; teacher.

jutsu.canon_description: Fires a large stream/bullet of flame from the mouth; commonly used in combination with other natures.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Fast straight projectile; doubled damage when combined with an ally's Wind jutsu (combo system). Learn: genin; scroll.

jutsu.name_en: Fire Release: Fire Dragon Flame Bullet
jutsu.canon_description: Exhales a large stream of fire that takes the shape of a dragon.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Sweeping flame-dragon beam over 2 s, leaves burning trail. Learn: chunin; scroll from a mission reward.

jutsu.canon_description: Exhales a cloud of chakra-laden ash that the user ignites by clicking their teeth, causing an explosion.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Two-stage cast: place an ash cloud (blinds), then detonate for AoE burn. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Exhales a massive wall of fire covering a huge area.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Huge cone/wave ultimate with long cooldown. Learn: jonin; requires mastering Great Fireball + large chakra pool.

jutsu.canon_description: A clan secret that releases a large torrent of flames.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Clan-locked long cone of fire; only for players from a Sarutobi-like fire clan. Learn: clan elder.

jutsu.canon_description: Creates a dense mist that hides the user; usable near water and amplified by the user's chakra.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Creates a fog zone: player gains stealth, enemies lose lock-on; pairs with Silent Killing backstabs. Learn: genin, Water affinity; scroll.

jutsu.canon_description: Creates solid clones made of water that can fight but are weaker than the user and burst when hit hard.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Water-clone pets with ~10% player stats; better near water. Learn: genin; Water teacher.

jutsu.canon_description: Traps the target inside a sphere of heavy water; the user must keep a hand inside to maintain it.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Channelled bind: target trapped while the player stands still holding the prison; clones can maintain it. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Fires high-pressure bullets of water at the target.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Rapid-fire water bolts; cheap ranged poke. Learn: genin; Water affinity scroll.

jutsu.canon_description: Spits or raises water into a wall around/in front of the user to block attacks (especially fire).
jutsu.game_suggestion: Temporary dome/wall that absorbs projectiles; doubles block vs Fire. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.name_en: Water Release: Water Shark Bullet Technique
jutsu.canon_description: Forms water into a large shark that tracks and rams the target.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Homing projectile shark; bigger near water sources. Learn: chunin; Water teacher.

jutsu.name_en: Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Technique
jutsu.canon_description: Shapes a large body of water into a dragon that crashes into the target; requires 44 hand seals.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Big line projectile with knockback; long cast time that shortens with seal-speed skill (good showcase for a hand-seal minigame). Learn: chunin; requires nearby water.

jutsu.name_en: Water Release: Exploding Water Colliding Wave
jutsu.canon_description: Spews a massive volume of water that floods the area, creating a lake for further water techniques.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Turns arena into water terrain (buffs Water jutsu, slows enemies). Learn: jonin.

jutsu.canon_description: Raises a huge vortex of water from a nearby source and crashes it onto the target like a waterfall.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Large AoE wave with knockdown; needs water nearby. Learn: jonin.

jutsu.canon_description: Releases a powerful gust of wind that blows away everything in front of the user.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Cone knockback, deflects incoming projectiles and boosts Fire jutsu passing through. Learn: genin, Wind affinity.

jutsu.canon_description: Claps hands to release a gust that accelerates thrown weapons or other techniques.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Buff: next thrown weapon gains speed/damage; also small push. Learn: genin.

jutsu.canon_description: Creates a slashing whirlwind (often with a fan) that cuts everything it hits.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Wide slicing wave with bleed; stronger with a war fan weapon. Learn: genin/chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Fires compressed bullets of air at the target.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Cheap fast invisible-ish projectiles (distortion VFX). Learn: genin.

jutsu.canon_description: Exhales a rapid barrage of compressed wind bullets that pierce targets.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Machine-gun burst of wind bullets (stand-in for 'Vacuum Bullet'). Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Exhales a sweeping blade of wind that cuts in a wide arc.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Spin-sweep 180-360 deg slash wave. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Releases a highly compressed tornado-like blast that devastates a wide area.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Large AoE blast at target location. Learn: jonin.

jutsu.canon_description: Adds wind nature to a Rasengan, forming a shuriken of microscopic wind blades that damages the target at the cellular level.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Ultimate: thrown projectile that expands into a huge cutting sphere; inflicts self-damage debuff on overuse. Learn: late-game jonin; requires Rasengan + Wind nature mastery + extensive Shadow Clone training.

jutsu.name_en: Earth Release: Hiding Like a Mole Technique
jutsu.canon_description: User burrows through the ground like a mole to move unseen or ambush.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Burrow state: untargetable underground movement, ends with an uppercut ambush. Learn: genin, Earth affinity.

jutsu.canon_description: Raises a thick wall of earth from the ground (or spat mud) to block attacks.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Placeable destructible wall/cover; blocks all projectiles until broken. Learn: genin/chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Shapes the ground into sharp spikes of rock that impale opponents.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Line of erupting ground spikes along the floor, launches enemies. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Raises an earthen dragon head that spits mud bullets; combined with fire they become flaming bullets.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Turret summon that fires mud balls; Fire combo turns them into fireballs. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Encloses the user and allies in a protective dome of rock.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Group shield dome for 3 s. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.name_en: Earth Release: Swamp of the Underworld
jutsu.canon_description: Turns the ground into a deep swamp of mud that swallows anything on it.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Ground AoE that roots and sinks enemies (damage over time, giants become stuck). Learn: jonin.

jutsu.canon_description: Concentrates lightning chakra in the hand, producing chirping birds' sound, then charges into the target with a piercing thrust.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Charge then straight dash-thrust with armor-pierce; needs high speed stat (tunnel-vision weakness: easy to counter). Learn: chunin/jonin; Lightning teacher + speed training.

jutsu.canon_description: A refined, more powerful form of Chidori capable of cutting through almost anything.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Upgrade of Chidori (skill tree evolution); higher damage, lightning-clash cancel. Learn: jonin.

jutsu.canon_description: Fires a spear-like bolt of lightning from the mouth that pierces targets.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Fast piercing beam that chains to a second target. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Raises four pillars around the target which emit lightning, trapping and paralysing them.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Placeable square trap; enemies inside are stunned and shocked. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Calls down a bolt of lightning on the target.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Targeted delayed strike from above with AoE stun. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Cloaks the body in lightning chakra, stimulating nerves for extreme speed and reflexes while also acting as armour.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Toggle buff draining chakra/sec: +move speed, +attack speed, damage reduction, unlocks lightning taijutsu (e.g. Hell Stab). Learn: jonin.

jutsu.canon_description: Coats the fingertips in lightning chakra to pierce the target with a spear-hand strike.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Melee thrust combo-ender; requires Lightning Chakra Mode active for full damage. Learn: jonin.

jutsu.canon_description: A sphere of rapidly rotating, compressed chakra held in the palm that grinds into the target; needs no hand seals.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Melee charge-orb: hold to charge, release on contact for big knockback/spin damage. Learn: chunin; 3-stage training (water balloon -> rubber ball -> balloon) from a master.

jutsu.canon_description: Makes the target see a horrifying vision of their worst fears.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Fear debuff: target flees / attacks lowered for 3 s. Learn: genin; genjutsu teacher.

jutsu.canon_description: Makes targets believe they are walking in a straight line while they are actually led in circles.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Field genjutsu: enemies/pursuers inside zone wander or patrol in circles; great for stealth/escape. Learn: genin/chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Makes the target believe they are bound by a tree, letting the user strike them.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Bind + guaranteed crit on next hit; break with Genjutsu Release (chakra disruption). Learn: chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Plunges targets into complete darkness, cutting off their vision.
jutsu.game_suggestion: AoE blind: enemies lose screen/lock-on; for the player it darkens their vignette. Learn: jonin.

jutsu.canon_description: Medical technique that channels chakra through the hands to accelerate healing of wounds.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Channelled heal (self/ally) while standing still; requires high chakra control stat. Learn: genin/chunin medical path; hospital training (heal fish/plants minigame).

jutsu.canon_description: Forms chakra into a fine blade on the hand that can cut muscle and tendons internally without an open wound.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Melee stance applying 'severed' debuffs (slow, weaker attacks). Learn: chunin medical path.

jutsu.canon_description: Draws poison out of a patient's body using a sphere of water and chakra.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Cleanse poison/DOT from ally; quest utility. Learn: chunin medical path.

jutsu.canon_description: Exhales a large cloud of poison gas created through medical knowledge.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Poison cloud AoE with DOT. Learn: chunin; requires medical knowledge.

jutsu.canon_description: Gathers chakra in a fist and releases it at the moment of impact for devastating strength that shatters the ground.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Ground-pound punch shockwave; scales with chakra control. Learn: chunin medical path.

jutsu.canon_description: Stores chakra in a seal on the forehead over years and releases it to power regeneration and techniques.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Late-game passive: chakra bank fills slowly over time; activate for auto-regen + unlimited chakra for a short window. Learn: jonin medical master quest.

jutsu.canon_description: Accelerates cell division to regenerate organs and tissue instantly, at the cost of the user's lifespan.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Full-heal ability that permanently costs a tiny bit of max HP per use. Learn: endgame.

jutsu.canon_description: A spinning roundhouse kick sequence.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Spinning kick AoE knockback; combo starter. Learn: academy/genin; taijutsu dojo.

jutsu.canon_description: An upward kick that launches the opponent into the air.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Launcher for air combos. Learn: genin; dojo.

jutsu.canon_description: A flying kick used to enter a battle and strike an opponent.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Jump-kick gap closer. Learn: genin.

jutsu.canon_description: Launches the opponent high, binds them with bandages and piledrives them into the ground; requires opening the first gate.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Cinematic grab finisher, costs HP. Learn: chunin; requires Eight Gates gate 1.

jutsu.canon_description: Forcibly opens chakra limiters in the body, giving immense power at the cost of severe physical damage; opening all eight is fatal.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Tiered self-buff: each gate opened gives big stat boost and HP drain; gate 8 = death (game over or permanent loss). Learn: gated progression via a taijutsu master; one gate per arc.

jutsu.canon_description: A fighting style that strikes the chakra pathway system with chakra-infused palm strikes, damaging internal organs.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Alternate melee moveset dealing chakra-drain damage and sealing enemy jutsu. Learn: Hyūga-style clan only.

jutsu.canon_description: A rapid sequence of 64 strikes that seals the target's chakra points.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Stance-then-flurry; target cannot use jutsu for several seconds. Learn: clan, chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Releases chakra from all tenketsu while spinning, creating a rotating dome that deflects attacks.
jutsu.game_suggestion: 360 deg spin shield that reflects projectiles and knocks back. Learn: clan, chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Extends the user's shadow to connect with the target's, forcing them to mimic the user's movements.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Ground-line bind whose range depends on light/shadows in the scene; while bound, enemy copies your movement. Learn: clan.

jutsu.canon_description: After capturing a target with shadow, the shadow climbs up their body and strangles them.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Follow-up to Shadow Imitation: DOT while bound. Learn: clan.

jutsu.canon_description: Sharpens shadow tendrils into needles that pierce and bind multiple targets.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Multi-target piercing tendrils + root. Learn: clan, chunin.

jutsu.canon_description: Converts calories into chakra to enlarge the user's body (or parts of it).
jutsu.game_suggestion: Grow: bigger hitboxes, more damage and HP, slower; consumes 'calorie' resource restored by eating. Learn: clan.

jutsu.canon_description: After expanding, the user rolls at high speed as a giant ball to crush enemies.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Steerable rolling charge with knockdown. Learn: clan; requires Multi-Size.

jutsu.canon_description: Directs chakra-eating insects hosted in the body to swarm and drain targets or form shields and clones.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Swarm projectile that drains enemy chakra over time; insect resource meter. Learn: clan.

jutsu.canon_description: Forms a clone out of insects that can disperse to escape attacks.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Decoy that, when hit, becomes a drain swarm. Learn: clan.

jutsu.canon_description: The user and ninken partner spin like drills and slam into the target together.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Drill-dash done together with a dog companion pet. Learn: clan; requires ninken companion bond level.

jutsu.canon_description: Projects the user's mind into a target to take control of their body; the user's own body is left defenceless.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Slow projectile; on hit player controls the enemy for X s while own body is vulnerable. Learn: clan.

jutsu.canon_description: Links minds to let several people communicate telepathically.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Party telepathy: reveals ally positions/quest markers. Learn: clan.

jutsu.canon_description: Creates clones made of wood that can travel far and merge with trees.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Long-range scout clones. Learn: Wood Release bloodline only.

jutsu.canon_description: Grows a full wooden house from the ground.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Camp/rest point anywhere in the open world (save + heal). Learn: Wood Release bloodline.

jutsu.canon_description: Surrounds the target with ice mirrors; the user moves between them at great speed attacking from all angles.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Arena-trap: dome of mirrors, player teleports mirror-to-mirror firing senbon. Learn: Ice Release bloodline.

jutsu.canon_description: Grows bone blades from the user's body and attacks in a fluid dance.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Bone-blade melee moveset with wide arcs. Learn: Dead Bone Pulse bloodline.

jutsu.canon_description: Spits a corrosive fluid that melts whatever it touches.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Acid spray cone that melts armor (defence down). Learn: Lava Release bloodline.

jutsu.canon_description: Fires multiple beams of energy that can be steered to chase targets.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Volley of homing lasers. Learn: Storm Release bloodline.

jutsu.canon_description: Infuses a punch with explosive chakra that detonates on contact.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Explosive punch with AoE. Learn: Explosion Release bloodline.

jutsu.canon_description: Places a seal with the five fingertips that disrupts the target's chakra flow.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Debuff: disables target's jutsu for long duration; also used for quest 'seal the beast' events. Learn: jonin; sealing master.

jutsu.canon_description: Uses chakra threads from the fingertips to control combat puppets loaded with weapons and poison.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Pet-control class: puppet with its own loadout (blades, poison darts, shield); player is weak while puppeteering. Learn: Sand-village-style puppet workshop.

jutsu.canon_description: Blends natural energy with chakra to dramatically enhance physical power, jutsu, and senses; gathering it requires remaining perfectly still and too much energy turns the user to stone.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Meditate in place to fill a nature meter (vulnerable), then transform: big buff to all stats, sensing, enhanced jutsu. Overfill = petrification debuff. Learn: endgame; train at a summon-animal sanctuary.

dojutsu.name: Sharingan
abilities: Clairvoyance-level perception of chakra and fast movement
Copies observed ninjutsu, genjutsu and taijutsu (not kekkei genkai)
dojutsu.game_suggestion: Bloodline-locked awakening event (emotional story trigger). Toggle mode draining chakra: slow-mo dodge windows, enemy attack telegraphs, and a 'copy' mechanic that learns an enemy jutsu after observing it N times. Tomoe level = upgrade tiers.

dojutsu.name: Mangekyō Sharingan
abilities: Unique per-user techniques (e.g. Amaterasu black flames, Tsukuyomi genjutsu, Kamui space-time, Susanoo chakra avatar)
dojutsu.game_suggestion: Endgame evolution; each use adds a permanent 'eye strain' stat that reduces vision until cured by a rare quest. Best avoided or kept as NPC-only power.

dojutsu.name: Byakugan
abilities: Sees chakra pathway system and tenketsu points
dojutsu.game_suggestion: Toggle detection mode: highlights enemies/loot through walls, shows weak points (crit zones) and a small blind-spot cone the player must cover. Enables the Gentle Fist moveset.

dojutsu.name: Rinnegan
abilities: Use of all five natures plus yin and yang
Six Paths techniques (attraction/repulsion, soul removal, summoning, etc.)
dojutsu.game_suggestion: Legendary tier; keep for bosses or a secret ending rather than as a player progression item.

dojutsu.name: Ketsuryūgan
dojutsu.game_suggestion: Optional obscure bloodline: blood-manipulation hemorrhage debuffs and eye-contact genjutsu.

tools.name: Kunai
tools.description: Standard double-edged dagger with a ring pommel; used for stabbing, throwing, climbing, and carrying explosive tags or wire.
tools.game_suggestion: Default melee + throwable; ammo stack (e.g. 10). Can carry an explosive tag or a teleport marker in advanced builds.

tools.name: Shuriken
tools.description: Small throwing stars (typically four points) used to wound, distract, or pin; often thrown in volleys.
tools.game_suggestion: Fast low-damage projectile volley (3 per throw); can curve with skill. Academy target-practice minigame.

tools.name: Fūma Shuriken
tools.description: Large folding windmill shuriken thrown with great force.
tools.game_suggestion: Heavy boomerang-like projectile with return arc.

tools.name: Senbon
tools.description: Thin throwing needles aimed at vital points, sometimes poisoned or used medically to induce a false death state.
tools.game_suggestion: Precision projectile with weak-point crit and status (poison/paralysis).

tools.name: Explosive Tag
tools.description: Paper tag inscribed with a seal that explodes when activated; often attached to kunai or set as traps.
tools.game_suggestion: Consumable: stick to kunai, wall or enemy; remote or timed detonation; trap-laying for stealth missions.

tools.name: Smoke Bomb
tools.description: Small sphere that releases a thick smoke cloud to cover escape or ambush.
tools.game_suggestion: Consumable: breaks aggro/lock-on, enables escape from fights and stealth repositioning.

tools.name: Soldier Pill
tools.description: Ration pill that restores stamina and chakra for a long period; a strong variant can produce exhaustion afterwards.
tools.game_suggestion: Consumable chakra/stamina restore over time with a post-effect fatigue debuff; craftable by clans/medical path.

tools.name: Ninja Wire
tools.description: Strong thin wire used for traps, binding, and channelling techniques.
tools.game_suggestion: Tether tool: bind enemies between posts, set tripwires, conduct Fire (Dragon Fire Technique).

tools.name: Makibishi
tools.description: Caltrops scattered on the ground to slow pursuers.
tools.game_suggestion: Ground trap slowing and damaging enemies that walk over it.

tools.name: Scroll
tools.description: Used to store sealed weapons/objects, summon contracts, and record techniques.
tools.game_suggestion: Inventory expansion (sealed weapons) and the main item form for learning jutsu.

tools.name: Forehead Protector
tools.description: Metal plate on cloth bearing the village symbol; proof of graduation from the Academy.
tools.game_suggestion: Earned at graduation; cosmetic identity item that unlocks missions board access.

tools.name: Flak Jacket
tools.description: Protective vest with scroll pouches worn by chūnin and above.
tools.game_suggestion: Armor unlocked at chunin promotion, adds extra consumable slots.

ranks.name: Academy Student
ranks.description: Child trainee learning chakra basics, hand seals, the three academy techniques, shuriken and taijutsu.
ranks.how_promoted: Pass the graduation exam (written + practical) administered by a chūnin instructor; receive a forehead protector.

ranks.name: Genin
ranks.description: Lowest ninja rank; placed in a three-man cell under a jōnin-sensei; mainly D- and C-rank missions.
ranks.how_promoted: Graduate the Academy, then pass the jōnin-sensei's own test (failure can send students back to the Academy).

ranks.name: Chūnin
ranks.description: Mid-rank ninja valued for leadership and tactics; leads squads; C- and B-rank missions; may wear the flak jacket.
ranks.how_promoted: Pass the Chūnin Exams; promotion is judged on overall ability and judgment, not simply winning matches.

ranks.name: Tokubetsu Jōnin
ranks.description: Special jōnin: a specialist in one area (e.g. interrogation, a particular combat skill) between chūnin and jōnin.

ranks.name: Jōnin
ranks.description: Elite, highly experienced ninja serving as captains; usually command two or more elemental natures; A-rank missions, can lead genin teams.
ranks.how_promoted: Recommendation by the Kage and peers (an exam may be required in some cases; anime shows a Jōnin Exam).

ranks.name: Anbu
ranks.description: Masked special operations unit under the Kage's direct command handling assassination, special missions and hunting missing-nin.

ranks.name: Kage
ranks.description: Leader of a great shinobi village; the strongest ninja.
ranks.how_promoted: Chosen by the village leadership and the country's daimyō.

ranks.description: Assigned to genin fresh from the Academy; almost no risk.
For experienced genin or chūnin; little to no chance of combat with ninja.
For experienced chūnin; combat with other ninja expected.
For jōnin; village- or state-level matters.
For experienced jōnin; state-level classified matters.

missions.notes: If a client lies about the danger (mission exceeds its rank), ninja are no longer obligated to finish it. Mercenary missions are unranked. Konoha tradition: a ninja's first mission is received directly from the Hokage.
missions.game_suggestion: Mission board filtered by rank; pay goes to the squad/village with a share to the player. A 'misranked mission' twist (C-rank that becomes B/A) is a great early-story hook.

chunin_exam.description: Joint exam held twice a year by allied villages; genin enter as three-man teams nominated by their jōnin-sensei; entrants sign waivers for injury/death; trickery is allowed.

stages.description: Hour-long 10-question test where the first nine are too hard; the hidden objective is to gather information (cheat) without being caught (penalty points). The tenth question tests resolve: accept risk of never retaking the exam or forfeit with the team.
stages.game_suggestion: Stealth/perception minigame: use jutsu (Byakugan, mind/insect techniques, clones) to copy answers without being spotted by proctors; final moral-choice question.

stages.description: Five days in a dangerous forest; each team gets a Heaven or Earth scroll and must obtain the other and reach the central tower with all members; opening scrolls early is punished.
stages.game_suggestion: Open-zone survival with team PvE/PvNPC battles for scrolls, foraging, traps, night ambushes and a time limit.

stages.description: If too many pass, random one-on-one matches; only winners advance, independent of teammates.
stages.game_suggestion: Randomised 1v1 bracket against rival NPC genin.

stages.description: Held one month later in a stadium before an audience including feudal lords; one-on-one tournament. Promotion is decided on demonstrated skill and judgment, not only victory.
stages.game_suggestion: One-month training interlude (choose a teacher, learn a new jutsu), then tournament; promotion score based on style/tactics, so losing can still promote.

academy_graduation.description: Graduation usually consists of a written exam and a practical exam, administered by a chūnin instructor (classically demonstrating a technique such as the Clone Technique). Graduates receive a forehead protector and are placed into three-man genin squads under a jōnin-sensei, who may give their own test and can send failing students back. Not every lesson must be mastered to pass (strong taijutsu or another technique can compensate). Typical admission age is about six.
academy_graduation.game_suggestion: Tutorial chapter: lessons unlock hand seals one by one, then the three academy techniques; final exam = written quiz + practical (perform Clone Technique via seal-input minigame) + optional sparring. Then a sensei 'survival test' (e.g. take bells/items from the sensei as a team) decides squad placement.

training_methods.name: Hand Seal Drills
training_methods.description: Memorising and speeding up the twelve seals; skilled ninja need fewer seals for the same technique.
training_methods.game_suggestion: Seal-input combo minigame (keys/controller directions = animals); seal speed stat lowers cast times and lets you drop seals.

training_methods.name: Leaf Concentration Exercise
training_methods.description: Sticking a leaf to the forehead with chakra as a basic chakra control drill.

training_methods.name: Tree Climbing Practice
training_methods.description: Walking up a tree using only the feet by focusing a precise amount of chakra in the soles; too much repels, too little slips.
training_methods.game_suggestion: Meter-balancing minigame; reward: wall-running ability + chakra control stat + max chakra up.

training_methods.name: Water Surface Walking Practice
training_methods.description: Harder control drill: continuously emit and adjust chakra from the feet to stand and walk on water.
training_methods.game_suggestion: Unlocks water-walking traversal (lakes become walkable) and higher chakra control; prerequisite for many Water jutsu.

training_methods.name: Chakra Nature Affinity Test
training_methods.description: Chakra paper reacts to the user's nature: burns (fire), splits (wind), wrinkles (lightning), crumbles (earth), dampens (water).
training_methods.game_suggestion: Post-graduation event that assigns elemental affinity.

training_methods.name: Nature Transformation Training
training_methods.description: Element-specific drills, e.g. cutting a leaf with wind chakra, splitting a waterfall for wind/water, burning a leaf for fire.
training_methods.game_suggestion: Per-element training quests that raise nature mastery, unlocking higher-rank jutsu of that nature.

training_methods.name: Rasengan Three-Step Training
training_methods.description: Rotation (pop a water balloon), power (burst a rubber ball), and containment (keep a balloon still while rotating chakra inside).
training_methods.game_suggestion: Three-stage quest chain with escalating minigames; reward Rasengan.

training_methods.name: Shadow Clone Training
training_methods.description: Experience gained by shadow clones returns to the user when they are dispelled, multiplying training speed (but chakra and mental fatigue too).
training_methods.game_suggestion: Training XP multiplier equal to clone count, with fatigue cost.

training_methods.name: Weighted Taijutsu Training
training_methods.description: Training with heavy weights and extreme physical regimens to build speed and strength.
training_methods.game_suggestion: Equip weights to gain bonus taijutsu XP; remove in combat for a temporary speed burst.

training_methods.name: Senjutsu Training
training_methods.description: Learning to stay perfectly still and absorb natural energy at a sacred summon-animal location; failure risks turning to stone.
training_methods.game_suggestion: Late-game meditation minigame unlocking Sage Mode.

training_methods.name: Genjutsu Release Practice
training_methods.description: Disrupting one's own chakra flow (or having an ally do it) to break an illusion.
training_methods.game_suggestion: Teach a 'Kai' button press/QTE that breaks genjutsu debuffs.
